'''Steve Daniel''' (also published as '''Steve Daniels''') is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[April 2000 San Jose tournament]] on 8 April 2000 with Tosche Mains, according to Alfred Dong's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d503">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-11-san-jose-california-4-8d503/ san-jose-california-4-8], DeckTech (Alfred "ThaBraHmaBuL" Dong, 11 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-11-san-jose-california-4-8d503/ GitHub Pages].</ref> He finished 3rd at the [[June 2000 San Jose tournament (10 June)]] on 10 June 2000 with "Anti-Profit" Alien Madness, according to Alfred Dong's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d872">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-11-san-jose-ca-6-11d872/ san-jose-ca-6-11], DeckTech (Alfred "ThaBraHmaBuL" Dong, 11 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-11-san-jose-ca-6-11d872/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
